subject: Stopping statins after 75: no survival penalty, but cholesterol climbs
script: From Agewell Brief: Stopping statins after 75: no survival penalty, but cholesterol climbs. A randomized trial finds that discontinuing statins in older adults without prior cardiovascular events does not raise three-year mortality, yet LDL rises sharply. The decision hinges on biology, not habit. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
